strings.text: Granite steps down to the water under an old bridge.
strings.translation: Degraus de granito descendo até a água sob uma velha ponte.

strings.text: A river bus with its lights on has come out from under the far bridge
strings.translation: Um barco de passeio com as luzes acesas saiu de debaixo da ponte distante

strings.text: The spans of the far bridge have risen: the bridge is up
strings.translation: Os vãos da ponte distante subiram: a ponte está levantada

strings.text: The spans of the far bridge have come down: the bridge is closed
strings.translation: Os vãos da ponte distante desceram: a ponte está fechada

strings.text: The lamp under the arch has come on
strings.translation: O poste sob o arco acendeu

strings.text: The lamp under the arch has gone out
strings.translation: O poste sob o arco apagou
